test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 11 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

A stitch in time saves nine.

options.text: It is good to stitch together small bits.
It is better to solve a problem straight away and not let it become bigger.
Time spent on useless activities must be avoided.
It is better to take timely action and you will become prosperous.

solution:
The correct answer is '**It is better to solve a problem straight away and not let it become bigger.**'.
